name: Heavy Duty Expansion Wedge Anchor Fasteners for Concrete Mounting (M10-M16)
shortDescription: Grade 8.8 zinc-plated wedge expansion anchor bolts with 360° stainless steel expansion clip for heavy equipment and structural steel baseplate anchoring in concrete.
overview: Engineered for heavy-duty structural anchoring into solid cured concrete and dense stone, these wedge expansion anchor fasteners deliver extraordinary pullout and shear resistance. Cold-formed from Grade 8.8 high-tensile carbon steel with a heavy yellow zinc dichromate coating, each anchor is equipped with a specialized 360-degree wrapped stainless steel expansion clip with outward-facing grip dimples. As the hex nut is torqued to specification, the tapered cone expands the clip firmly into the concrete borehole walls, creating permanent mechanical interlock.
keyFeatures: Manufactured from high-tensile Grade 8.8 carbon steel with zinc dichromate finish
Heavy-gauge 360° stainless steel expansion clip ensures uniform circumferential expansion
Certified for heavy structural anchor loads in non-cracked and cracked cured concrete
Dog-point rounded bottom tip prevents thread damage when driven into borehole
Head stamped with length code for straightforward post-installation inspection
Supplied fully assembled with high-tensile hex nut and thick flat steel washer
High resistance to dynamic vibratory loads from heavy industrial motors and presses
applications: Securing structural steel column baseplates and facade brackets to concrete slabs
Anchoring heavy industrial CNC machines, punch presses, and hydraulic lifts
Installing warehouse pallet racking uprights and safety barrier bollards
Fixing exterior fire escape staircases, stadium seating, and bridge railing posts
packageContents: 1x Box of Heavy Duty Wedge Anchor Bolts (Complete with Nuts & Washers)
specsSummary: Anchor Diameters: M10, M12, M16, M20 | Material Grade: High-Tensile Carbon Steel Grade 8.8
